user.title: Connect to ElOverblik
user.description: Paste a refresh token from [{site}]({url}). Open Datadeling, create a token for the metering points you want to share, and paste it here. The token stays valid for up to a year.

data_description.refresh_token: Created under Datadeling on eloverblik.dk. It is stored in Home Assistant and used only to read your own DataHub metering data.

reauth_confirm.title: Update the refresh token
reauth_confirm.description: ElOverblik rejected the refresh token for {name}. It has expired or been revoked. Create a new one under Datadeling on eloverblik.dk and paste it here.

data_description.refresh_token: The new token replaces the one that stopped working. Your selected metering points are kept.

metering_points.title: Choose metering points
metering_points.description: Consumption is electricity bought from the grid. Export/sale is electricity delivered to the grid, for example from solar panels. Production (D01, D09) is everything the panels produce, including what you use yourself, so it is not the same as export. Other points, such as D12 total consumption or D14 electrical heating, overlap the grid points. Only grid points are preselected. If a parent point and its children are both listed, prefer the children (D07 for grid consumption and D06 for export) so the Energy dashboard does not count the same electricity twice. Points another ElOverblik entry already monitors are not listed.

error.invalid_auth: ElOverblik rejected the refresh token. Create a new one under Datadeling on eloverblik.dk.
error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant could not reach ElOverblik, or ElOverblik returned an error. Wait a moment and try again.
error.rate_limited: ElOverblik is limiting requests right now. Wait a minute, then try again.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong while contacting ElOverblik.
error.no_selection: Select at least one metering point.
error.invalid_option: The polling interval must be between 1 and 24 hours, and the history must be between 1 and 1825 days.

abort.already_configured: This ElOverblik account, or every metering point it can see, is already configured.
abort.already_in_progress: This ElOverblik account is already being configured.
abort.no_metering_points: This account has no linked metering points. Link a metering point on eloverblik.dk and try again.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The new token belongs to a different ElOverblik account.

metering_points.title: Choose metering points
metering_points.description: Add or remove metering points. A point you remove loses its device and sensors, but the statistics already imported for it are kept. If two points report the same values (for example E17 and its D07 child, or E18 and D06), keep one of them so the same electricity is not counted twice. Points another ElOverblik entry monitors are not listed.

settings.title: ElOverblik options
settings.description: ElOverblik publishes metering data with a delay of about one to three days. Polling every few hours is enough and stays inside Energinet's rate limits.

data_description.scan_interval_hours: How often metering data is fetched. Minimum 1 hour. The default is 6 hours.
data_description.history_days: How many days are written to the Energy dashboard. Maximum 1825 days (5 years). The default is 180 days. Increasing this backfills older hours and rewrites the cumulative sum. The rebuild statistics action does the same on demand.
data_description.import_statistics: Writes hourly consumption and export as long-term statistics, so you can pick them under grid consumption and return to grid.

error.invalid_option: The polling interval must be between 1 and 24 hours, and the history must be between 1 and 1825 days.
error.no_selection: Select at least one metering point.
error.invalid_auth: ElOverblik rejected the refresh token. Only the points that are already selected are listed.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach ElOverblik. Only the points that are already selected are listed.
error.rate_limited: ElOverblik is limiting requests right now. Only the points that are already selected are listed.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Only the points that are already selected are listed.

rebuild_statistics.name: Rebuild statistics
rebuild_statistics.description: Clear the imported Energy dashboard statistics and write them again for the configured history (180 days by default) as one continuous cumulative sum. Increasing the statistics history does this automatically.

duplicate_metering_point.title: Two ElOverblik metering points report the same values

confirm.title: Stop monitoring the duplicate point?
confirm.description:
{remove} reports exactly the same hourly values as {keep}. DataHub often does this for a parent point and its child. Keeping both shows the same numbers twice and can count the same electricity twice in the Energy dashboard.

Submit to stop monitoring {remove} and keep {keep}. The device and sensors of {remove} are removed. Statistics that were already imported stay in Home Assistant. You can select the point again under the integration's options.

abort.entry_not_found: The ElOverblik entry no longer exists.
abort.already_deselected: This metering point is no longer selected.
abort.last_point: This is the last selected metering point, so it cannot be removed.
